CONSENT CALENDAR

Accept work performed by Sierra Mountain Construction Inc. for Contract No. HH-991, 2018 Mountain Tunnel Interim Repairs; approve Modification No. 3 (Final), increasing the contract amount by $297,390 and increasing the contract duration by 183 consecutive calendar days (approximately six months) for a total contract amount of $6,813,006 and a total contract duration of 439 consecutive calendar days

Approve the novation of Agreement No. PRO.0061, Federal Legislative Representation and Advocacy Services; authorize the General Manager to execute a Novation Agreement for the existing Agreement No. PRO.0061, from Daryl Owen Associates, Inc., to Owen Evans Ingols, Inc.; approve Amendment No. 2, increasing the agreement amount up to $20,000, with no change in the agreement duration, for a total not-to-exceed agreement amount of $1,220,000, and removing the requirement for 5% withholding from each invoice; and authorize the General Manager to execute this

Accept work performed by American Construction & Supply, Inc. for Contract No. WD-2770, Cathodic Protection for Transmission Pipelines at Various Locations - Phase 1; approve Modification No. 1 (Final), increasing the contract amount by $444,685 and increasing the contract duration by 324 consecutive calendar days (approximately 11 months), for a total

Accept work performed by Anvil Builders, Inc. for Contract No. WD-2838, Sunol Valley Water Treatment Plant Powdered Activated Carbon System for a total contract amount of $6,442,769, and a total contract duration of 397 consecutive calendar days (approximately one year and one month); and authorize final payment to the contractor. (How)

Approve the terms and conditions and authorize the General Manager to execute (1) a Utility Facility Transfer and Grant of Easement Agreement by and among Alemany Housing Associates, L.P., the Housing Authority, and the SFPUC, and (2) an eight-year, Temporary Electric Utility Easement Agreement between the Housing Authority and the SFPUC

Approve the terms and conditions of, and authorize the General Manager to execute, an Agreement for Purchase and Sale of Real Estate in the amount of $1,590,000, plus related transaction costs not-to-exceed $100,000, for the purchase from Michael Mitchell of approximately five acres of Alameda Watershed land, improved by a 2,890 square-foot single-family residence and certain personal property, commonly known as 12163 Calaveras Road in the unincorporated Town of Sunol, California (Alameda County Assessor’s Parcel No. 096-0100-015). This action constitutes the Approval Action for the project for the purposes of CEQA, pursuant to Section 31.04(h) of the San Francisco Administrative Code. (Carlin)

Award Job Order Contract No. JOC-74, General Engineering (A-License) for San Joaquin, Stanislaus, and Tuolumne Counties for a not-to-exceed amount of $5,000,000 and a duration of two years, to the sole responsible and responsive bidder, Sierra Mountain Construction, Inc., to perform General Engineering construction tasks for San Francisco Public Utilities Commission Enterprises and Bureaus in San Joaquin, Stanislaus, and Tuolumne Counties. (How)

Consent to the terms and conditions for the completion and acceptance of water, stormwater, and sewer infrastructure in the Mission Bay South Plan Area set forth in the Letter Agreement dated July 29, 2019 between the Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure, FOCIL-MB, LLC, and the City and County of San Francisco. (Carlin)
